name: adiabatic_flame_dissociation
title: Adiabatic flame temperature of CH4 or fuel oil with or without dissociation
summary: Adiabatic, constant-pressure combustion of CH4 or fuel oil with excess air: adiabatic flame temperature from H_reactants = H_products, with either complete-combustion products (CO2, H2O, O2, N2) or the 14-species chemical-equilibrium mixture from the EES built-in Chem_Equil procedure; species enthalpies from the EES built-in NASA procedure.

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (last run: CH4, DISSOCIATION$ = 'YES', e = 0.2, 30 bar, reactants at 288 K): T_adiab = 2417.129 K, H_react = H_prod = -78333.02 kJ/kmol fuel. The native file is blocked in CoolSolve (missing_features); no CoolSolve comparison yet - to be re-verified when the gaps close (T-RECHECK).
verification.notes: 26 of the 28 stored variables carry values (CO and NO cleared); the Oil-case records (MM_f, LHV_f, c_f, H_rf, H_ra, HHV, LHV_f_bis) belong to the alternative fuel case of this multi-case file. The stored ntot = 0.54286 kmol is inconsistent with the stored H-atom balance for the same run (flagged in the README, not resolvable without EES).
